story: Maren landed extra crates at night and Edda found out.
Edda wrote to the Board and told Maren so.
Maren climbed the tower after ten, cut the rail rope, and left the door unlocked.
Edda leaned on the rail at midnight and fell.

deductions.claim: Maren was in the tower after ten, though she says she was aboard.
Edda was about to expose Maren's unlogged crates.
The rail rope was cut, not worn, and Edda grabbed it as she fell.
